## Fiscal year

The fiscal year is the calendar year (it starts in January) and is labelled `FY 2026`, which is also the `{FY}` folder name and the `fy2026` tag.

## Smart-folder queries

Run these from the vault root; `mdfind` needs Spotlight indexing enabled for
this folder. `kagaz find` applies the same filters and does not need Spotlight.

```
# every document carrying a lifecycle tag
mdfind -onlyin . 'kMDItemUserTags == "active"c'
mdfind -onlyin . 'kMDItemUserTags == "confidential"c'
mdfind -onlyin . 'kMDItemUserTags == "dont-touch"c'
mdfind -onlyin . 'kMDItemUserTags == "encrypted"c'
mdfind -onlyin . 'kMDItemUserTags == "superseded"c'
mdfind -onlyin . 'kMDItemUserTags == "to-action"c'

# by area
mdfind -onlyin . 'kMDItemUserTags == "tax"c'

# by person, company or fiscal year: substitute a tag from the vocabulary above
mdfind -onlyin . 'kMDItemUserTags == "<tag>"c'

# two tags at once (this vault's tags are ANDed, like kagaz find --tag a --tag b)
mdfind -onlyin . 'kMDItemUserTags == "<tag>"c && kMDItemUserTags == "<other-tag>"c'

# free text in a document's indexed contents or its name
mdfind -onlyin . '(kMDItemTextContent == "*<text>*"cd || kMDItemDisplayName == "*<text>*"cd)'
```
